invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null list to process, as it calls methods on dedupedRecords.
The method assumes partitioner is non-null to call partitioner.getPartition(...).
The method must handle both empty and non-empty dedupedRecords, but this expresses that it is always one of these states.
The method maps over dedupedRecords, so elements must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
The implementation extracts record.getKey(), so keys are expected to be non-null.
